about_the_game:
The deeper you go, the closer you get to your last dive.

You’re going down.

Each floor is different. Grim beaches, creepy undergrounds, frozen mountains. But it’s dangerous everywhere. Somewhere down there is what you’re looking for but getting there is the hard part.

The elevator is your only way forward. Find it, fight your way to it, and descend.

⚙️ Key Features

💥 Brutal, slow-paced combat – Combat that hits hard but moves slow. Every bullet counts because ammo is scarce and enemies don’t wait for you.

🌍 Different environments every time – New levels every time you play. You won’t know what’s around the corner until you’re there.

👀 Enemies that keep you on the edge – Some run at you some stay still until you make noise.

🔧 Upgradable weapons – Start with classics, then tune them to fit your style. More firepower, faster reloads, until you schred enemies.

🧭 Tense exploration – Levels you have to explore not just run through. Loot, think, survive.

🧪 Coming Soon: Q1 2026 - Demo / Vertical Slice

✨ Add to Wishlist to follow development and help an indie game!
🎨 Support a brutal FPS with its own identity

Note: This project is very early, description and content are subject to change

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad core CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A tense and tactical FPS with roguelite progression. Descend level by level through dangerous, changing environments. Brutal, slow-paced combat where every shot counts. Find the elevator. Go deeper. Until it's your last dive.
